name: Baked Bedmi Puri
ingredients: ½ cup soaked and ground urad dal
Water and 1 tsp oil for the batch
steps: Mix flour, ground dal and spices.
Roll into small puris and brush lightly with oil.
Bake at 200°C / 400°F until cooked, turning once.
note: Baking reduces oil versus deep-frying, but it remains carbohydrate-rich.
